title: Free-Transformer factorial response certificate external validity
question: Do freely trained same-executor Transformers contain layerwise source-by-later-condition response objects that the calibrated finite-population certificate can type and independently replay across depth?

hypothesis_predictions.observable: Exact and sampled layerwise A0/B/J/A1 risks, typed certificate, answer-state causal admissibility and independent-donor replay.
hypothesis_predictions.expected: All models pass behavior; certificate false authorization is zero; robust and ambiguity gates pass; at least four of six models with every depth represented expose a causally admissible certified event whose independent-donor replay passes identity controls.
hypothesis_predictions.death_observation: Any conjunctive behavior/certificate gate fails, fewer than four models or one depth pass, or any selected independent-donor causal confirmation fails.

hypothesis_predictions.expected: Free networks lack a stable certifiable response type, or predictable response states do not yield independently replayable causal events across depth.

precision: FP64 candidate fit and risk certificate

data_contract.oracle_universe: All 3456 combinations of source/target identity, distinct base/changed shift and codebook order under a deterministic nuisance record.
data_contract.split_rule: Candidate type fits discovery; risk certificate samples the oracle universe; causal admissibility uses causal_selection; selected type is refit on donor; causal effect is tested only on confirmation.
leakage_audit: frozen candidate rank and RFF width

factor_design.A0: H10-H00 at one answer-boundary layer event
factor_design.B: H01-H00 for the later shift/codebook change

typed_gates.rule: All six models reach at least 0.995 training and frozen-world accuracy with executor gap at most 2e-4.
Zero false authorization; every behavior-qualified model has robust coverage at least 0.90 and exact-ambiguity abstention equal to one.
Causal selection uses exact answer-state sentinel and reverse block only; every frozen event then passes independent-donor correct/wrong confirmation.
At least four of six models pass, every depth contributes at least one model, every qualified model exposes at least one admissible event, and at least one non-additive type is certified.

budget.right_censoring_rule: One formal pass or fail closes WP02; no model, seed, layer, rank, RFF width or threshold repair.

stopping_rules: Behavior failures and abstentions remain in the denominator.
Exact population risks cannot select a type or layer.
Confirmation cannot change the selected type or event.
Failure closes C014 before any pretrained model.
Pass authorizes only design of a new pretrained contract, never automatic pretrained execution.

authorizes_on_pass: design one separately frozen pretrained-model contract
